recommendation_summary: The reply recommends keeping nightly-sync on edna and running a self-hosted Healthchecks container on the Synology as a dead-man switch: the script pings start and success, and the user gets an alert if success is missing for 24h.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You asked for notice of silent nightly-sync failure with no log reading.
labels.Deleted: Central log on Synology, moving everything to Docker, Pieter Levels style log tailing.
labels.Bottleneck: Crash before email makes success and failure both look like silence.
labels.Checked myself: Single cron job on edna at 03:00, email only on finish, 4x startup token crash with no signal, nothing else watches it, you will not read logs.

note: It is a single dead-man alert, but it is a self-hosted Healthchecks Docker container on the Synology, so it counts as LARGER despite the Deleted line rejecting Docker.
